meta.name: Daybreak Editorial — Magazine Finance UI
meta.sourceOfTruth: docs/desigh/reference/*.png — dashboard, addasset, insight-asset change, invest analysis, more
meta.intent: High-level creative direction for AI and humans: replicate a fashion-editorial, flat-color-block wealth app. Not generic fintech; not glassmorphism-first.
meta.productContext: Personal wealth / portfolio tracking. Data must stay trustworthy; the shell is expressive, poster-like, and calm.

creativeNorthStar.oneLiner: Every screen reads like a magazine spread: big type, flat color fields, intentional asymmetry, and cream paper between the ink.
metaphors: Editorial fashion spread (Vogue / Kinfolk energy, not Bloomberg terminal)
Paper collage: rectangles of color taped on a warm sheet
Poster hierarchy: one dominant message, then supporting bands

designPrinciples.name: Structure is color, not chrome
designPrinciples.rule: Separate regions with solid fills and alignment — not hairline borders, not nested outlined boxes. If you need a divider, use spacing or a new color band.

designPrinciples.name: Typography does the drama
designPrinciples.rule: Headlines and hero numbers are oversized serif; labels and metadata are smaller caps or sans. Scale contrast beats decoration.

designPrinciples.name: Right angles for architecture, pills for controls
designPrinciples.rule: Hero bands, category strips, and mastheads use 0–4px radius (structural). Segmented tabs, search fields, and tiny filters may use pills — never the whole page.

designPrinciples.name: One focal plane per viewport
designPrinciples.rule: Avoid stacking three equally loud layers. Either a masthead shouts, or the chart shouts — not both at full volume.

designPrinciples.name: Theme is swappable, grammar is fixed
designPrinciples.rule: Peach / sky / lemon in references are roles (block A, B, C), not fixed hex. User-chosen palettes must keep the same layout grammar.

designPrinciples.name: Money stays legible
designPrinciples.rule: Decorative layout must never reduce contrast on balances, returns, or warnings. Status red/green conventions stay intuitive.

screenCanvas.description: Warm off-white / cream full-screen ground (#F5F0E1–#FAF9F6 family). Never pure optic white as the only layer.
screenCanvas.bleed: Key sections (masthead, split metrics, category bands) may go edge-to-edge horizontally.

gridLogic.description: Use a loose 2-column or split flex logic: 60/40 or 50/50 for hero pairs; single column for lists below.
gridLogic.asymmetry: Deliberately offset: vertical accent bar beside a title, or one tall block beside two stacked blocks.

sectioningModel: Masthead band (brand + page intent + primary metric)
Footer band (two performance strips, tab bar)
layoutAndStructure.density: Low to medium. Generous padding inside color blocks (16–24px). Avoid cramming controls into mastheads.

spacing.philosophy: Negative space is part of the composition — empty cream areas separate color blocks as much as lines would.

structural.radius: 0px for primary rectangles (headers, split metrics, category rows, mastheads).
structural.intent: Reads as print layout, not app bubble.

controls.segmentedTab: Pill or rounded rectangle for active state; inactive sits on tinted flat ground.
controls.searchField: Full-width pill or soft capsule inside content band.
controls.chipsFilters: Pill or stadium; selected = filled solid accent; unselected = outline or soft tint.

elevation.default: Prefer flat. If needed, one soft diffuse shadow on floating elements only (tab bar, modal sheet) — never harsh drop shadows on every card.
elevation.avoid: Stacked glass cards with double shadows; thick borders around every module.

colorSystem.strategy: Cream neutral canvas + 3–5 saturated accents from a coordinated palette. Blocks carry mood; text is mostly near-black on light fills.

roles.blockPrimary: First accent (e.g. peach / orange) — mastheads, primary CTA strips, vertical accent bars
roles.blockSecondary: Second accent (e.g. sky blue) — paired columns, secondary metrics
roles.blockTertiary: Third accent (e.g. lemon / yellow) — tertiary bands, highlights
roles.ink: Primary text on light surfaces — near-black #141414–#2C3E50, not pure #000
roles.inkOnDark: White or near-white on deep charcoal / black bands
roles.mutedInk: Labels, captions — 55–72% opacity of ink on same surface

referencePaletteAnchors.note: Illustrative only — map to user theme swatches in app code.

financeSemantics.positive: Green family for up / gain — may be softened but must stay distinguishable
financeSemantics.negative: Red / rose family for down / loss
financeSemantics.neutral: Use ink or muted, not gray-50 on gray-50

pairing.display: High-contrast serif for mastheads, hero words, big numbers where editorial impact matters (e.g. Newsreader, Playfair-style).
pairing.ui: Clean geometric sans for labels, tabs, body, table cells, inputs (e.g. Inter).

mastheadWordmark.case: sentence or ALL CAPS for brand only

rules: Few sizes, strong steps — no wall of 15px text.
Serif for emotion and hierarchy; sans for reading efficiency.
Numbers that matter are larger than their labels, always.

dashboard.composition: Split header (two flat colors) + split primary metrics (large left total, right daily change) + cream list region with category rows (icon + label + value + optional side accent).
mustHave: No rounded outer cards for main structure

addAsset.composition: Vertical accent bar + huge ADD ASSET serif title + row of flat color rectangles for asset class + underline-only fields + full-width flat primary CTA with oversized word.
mustHave: Category as color tiles not chips

insightsAssetChange.composition: Orange masthead with brand + subtitle + net worth + segmented tabs (asset change / distribution / ROI) + chart with optional oversized figures overlapping gradient fill + two bottom strips (gainer / loser).
mustHave: Pill active tab on flat ground

investAnalysis.composition: Stacked serif title block + bubble/scatter chart + pill search + category filter row + list rows with large serif name left and solid color rectangle right containing %.
mustHave: Right-hand color block for key metric per row

more.composition: Large masthead + asymmetric grid: tall account block + stacked tool/data blocks + preferences band + support entries.
mustHave: Account as single tall color field

bottomNavigation.style: Light bar; thin top separation or none; line icons; active state = stronger ink or accent — not heavy fills.

masthead.layout: Full-width solid rectangle. Left: brand word (serif, large). Below: subtitle (sans, caps, tracked). Optional primary metric block.
masthead.height: Comfortable — not a minimal 44pt bar; feels like a cover.

splitMetricBand.layout: Two adjacent rectangles (flex split). Left often wider for primary number; right for secondary or delta.
splitMetricBand.text: Use `pickTextOnAccent`-style logic: light block → dark ink; dark block → light ink.

categorySelector.addFlow: Horizontal row of equal-height color rectangles; label in strong serif or bold sans; selected = outline or inner contrast shift.
categorySelector.insightsTabs: Segmented control: active = white or light pill on tinted field; inactive = flat on canvas.

formFields.default: Underline only (bottom border) or minimal bottom rule — no full box unless platform requires.
formFields.labels: Above or inline placeholder in serif or sans per screen consistency.

primaryButton.addFlow: Full-width rectangle, 0 radius, fill = primary accent; label in huge serif or bold (ADD).
primaryButton.standard: Flat filled rectangle or sharp stadium; avoid bubbly default iOS blue.

dataListRow.wealth: Left: name + subline. Right: large amount or percent. Optional vertical sliver of accent color.
dataListRow.investmentReturnRow: Left: serif asset name. Right: solid block with cumulative return % — black or white text on block per contrast.

charts.areaLine: Soft gradient fill under line; axis minimal; allow large typographic annotation inside chart area for hero metrics.
charts.scatterBubble: Glossy or flat circles with labels inside; grid light gray; axes labeled clearly but quietly.

settingsGrid.layout: Color blocks as cells, not white cards in void. Icons + short labels; grid 2–3 columns depending on width.
settingsGrid.preferences: Single wide low-chroma band for language + theme rows.

motion.feel: Calm and confident. Short fades; press = slight opacity or scale — not bouncy playfulness.
motion.principle: Motion supports comprehension; it does not replace hierarchy.

accessibility.contrast: All text on colored blocks must meet readable contrast; use dynamic `onBlock` text color.
accessibility.touchTargets: Maintain minimum 44pt hit areas even when layout looks editorial.
accessibility.data: Never rely on color alone for profit/loss — pair with sign, icon, or text.

themeIntegration.codeMapping: User-selectable palettes live in `AppPaletteTheme` (`lib/app-palette.ts`). Structural colors should derive from `swatches`, `pageBg`, `primary`, `categoryAccents`, `ctaPillBg` / `ctaPillText` — not hardcoded reference hex.
themeIntegration.layoutHelpers: Use `lib/editorial-reference-layout.ts` patterns (`magazineBlocks`, `magazineStrongOnBlock`) when implementing block-based UI.

do: Use flat rectangles and split layouts for primary structure.
Use serif display for mastheads and hero words.
Let cream/background breathe between saturated blocks.
Use color blocks to express hierarchy.
dont: Don't default to large rounded cards for every screen — references are mostly sharp.
Don't rely on 1px dividers everywhere — use bands and spacing.
Don't mix five loud accents in one viewport without a neutral anchor.
Don't shrink critical numbers to fit decoration.
Don't describe this system as 'glassmorphism-first' — glass is optional garnish, not the spine.

aiReplicationChecklist: 1. Set cream/off-white page background from theme `pageBg`.
2. Map masthead / split bands / vertical bar to `swatches[0..n]` and `ctaPillBg` — never one-off random hex unless prototyping.
3. Use serif for display lines and sans for UI chrome (match project fonts: Newsreader + Inter).
4. Prefer structural radius 0; reserve pills for tabs, chips, search.
5. Section with color + spacing, not borders.
6. For each screen, identify one hero (masthead, split metric, or chart) before adding secondary UI.
7. After layout, verify contrast on all money and status elements.
8. Cross-check `referenceScreens` for the feature being built.
